# Principal source sufficiency A — Fumiya, Hinami and Kikuchi

All three have sufficient literary evidence for distinct, bounded model construction in the domains below. This is an individual source-sufficiency recommendation, not root construction admission or a model/operational PASS. No principal model behavior or dialogue is authored here. Root must make a separate construction decision before behavior is produced; creators then preregister tests, construct distinct nonprimary models and obtain independent semantic/register review.

The basis is the31-version intentional Edition1 at `b498a20457e4debeb70895fca8ebd37717e91017`, release identifier `TOMOZAKI_JP_LN_V12_EDITION_1_20261103`, with actual adopted release records in `164a593d8ee6998cf735442d855135ababfee497`. The actual root adoption receipt was acquired. It distinguishes the literary prerequisite from publication of its new records and from individual admission. No future CI/main result is claimed here. Architecture v1.15 §16/§17.2 governs; STABILIZED is distinct from architecture FROZEN. Earlier R04/R05/V11 stage language inside preserved monographs retains its historical scope.

The three complete current monographs were personally acquired in contiguous bounded windows: Fumiya184,500bytes/1,038lines; Hinami217,498bytes/1,282lines; Kikuchi202,760bytes/1,211lines. Loadbearing portions of both dyads, current CS/REL/JVL and voice controls were acquired separately. The accompanying actual-read receipt names exact windows/identities, recovered clipping and mechanically pinned dependencies. Existing novel/diary/image consultations remain inherited; there were zero new primary calls or pixels.

## Common construction contract

The admissible unit is person + finite story-local episode/band + directional recipient/standing + actor information + stakes and available alternatives. A volume label alone is insufficient when a rupture, negotiation or disclosure occurs inside it. Select state → standing → known information/stakes → supported attention → competing ends/constraints → conditional act/register → negative/OOD checks. Later observed acts never repair earlier ignorance or permission. Reader knowledge, inward speech, attributed report and authored fiction require their own layers.

Below, SUPPORTED_LOCAL means evidence supports a conditional field at the stated scope. RESTRICTED means a field can be represented with alternatives, qualifications or retrieval only. UNESTABLISHED means the model must abstain rather than create a definitive value. These are local evidence decisions, not capability grades, probability measurements or owner calibration. A model should return usable in-domain alternatives; it should not hide every difficult question behind generic uncertainty. Equally, useful prose cannot certify an unobserved future.

## Tomozaki Fumiya — recommendation MR-P01

**SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_CONSTRUCTION.** Permitted responsibility: era-specific gaming/learning and competition, familiar-peer collaboration, recipient-fitted teaching, ordinary company, particular partner negotiation/repair, and historically evidenced failure patterns. Current professional purpose and route may be retrieved as aspiration/experiment; sustainable professional life, legal decisions and adult household enactment are excluded. The model must preserve pleasure and ordinary affiliation alongside mechanism-seeking and overreach.

### State catalog and access controls
